notes:
Prospect snapshot - mid-market product company building an in-app AI assistant and semantic search across docs. Evaluating Hosted API first to iterate fast, plan to move to Dedicated for predictable unit economics and isolation.

Key pain: token cost spikes during peak usage; observed tail-latency on hosted pilot. Team is cost sensitive but prioritizes reliability for in-app flows.

Summary of requirements and asks:
- Workload: chat-first (multi-turn) + embeddings for search, occasional reranking for relevance tuning.
- Throughput target: average 30-80 QPS, with bursts to 300 QPS during releases.
- Latency target: 95th < 150ms ideal, acceptable < 250ms for now.
- Cost sensitivity: target ARR-normalized inference cost reduction of 30-50% vs current hosted baseline.
- Model preference: open models (Llama-2 / Falcon family) with possibility to test newer quantized variants.
- Routing: want auto-fallback to lower-cost variant during congestion; can allow slightly degraded quality for non-critical queries.
- Security: SSO for staff, audit logs, SOC2 required; prefer KMS integration for key rotation.

POC & evaluation notes (shorthand):
- "Hosting first, Dedicated if unit economics make sense" (quote from CTO).
- POC uses hosted API; goal = prove perf/cost levers (batching, cache hit-rate, quant profiles).
- SE (Priya) to run experiments: 1) continuous batching with latency SLO, 2) prefix/cache warmup to hit 60%+ cache rate, 3) int8/int4 quant profile tradeoffs on cost vs quality.
- Data residency: US-only for customer data; legal OK so far.
- Drive artifacts: cost-model spreadsheet, workshop deck, POC run logs (links above).

Workshop outcomes & action items to date:
- 02/28 workshop: identified 3 quick wins -> increase batching window for non-interactive embeddings, enable prefix cache for repeated prompts, tune KV cache eviction TTLs. Expected 18-25% immediate token-cost reduction.
- SE to deliver bench scripts and recommended batching thresholds by 2025-03-09.
- Finance wants Dedicated pricing scenarios with 6/12/24 month commit tiers and clear break-even charts vs hosted.

Risks & open questions:
- Quality regressions with aggressive quantization - need eval set and golden prompts to measure.
- Burst capacity model for Dedicated: how to handle spiky launches without over-provisioning.
- Timeline: security team needs KMS integration plan before production sign-off (may add 4-6 weeks).

Quote from VP Eng: "If we can get to 30% lower inference spend without dropping UX, Dedicated is worth the commit."

Next: deep cost-workshop (batching/caching/quant profiles + unit econ modeling), finalize Dedicated sizing, deliver A/B on quantized model for core intents.
